Metadata.Title: RHSA-2026:100735: sos security, bug fix, and enhancement update (Important)
Metadata.Description:
The sos package contains a set of utilities that gather information from system hardware, logs, and configuration files. The information can then be used for diagnostic purposes and debugging.

Security Fix(es):

* sos: sos: path traversal in sos clean tar extraction via unvalidated symlink/hardlink targets leads to arbitrary file write (CVE-2026-79655)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* Hydra to GraphQL migration and sos upload [rhel-8.10.z] (JIRA:RHEL-290944)

* Hydra to GraphQL migration and sos upload (JIRA:RHEL-290945)

* Hydra to GraphQL migration and sos upload [rhel-9.4.z] (JIRA:RHEL-290946)

* Hydra to GraphQL migration and sos upload [rhel-9.6.z] (JIRA:RHEL-290947)

* Hydra to GraphQL migration and sos upload [rhel-9.8.z] (JIRA:RHEL-290948)

* Hydra to GraphQL migration and sos upload [rhel-10.0.z] (JIRA:RHEL-290951)

* Hydra to GraphQL migration and sos upload [rhel-10.2.z] (JIRA:RHEL-290952)

* Hydra to GraphQL migration and sos upload [rhel-8.4.z] (JIRA:RHEL-304344)

* Hydra to GraphQL migration and sos upload [rhel-8.6.z] (JIRA:RHEL-304345)

* Hydra to GraphQL migration and sos upload [rhel-8.8.z] (JIRA:RHEL-304346)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
